description.p: LGL Simple Colour Picker is a small Qt 6 desktop utility for sampling a colour from the screen and copying it in ready-to-paste HEX, RGB, and RGBA formats.
Version 1.0.0 is an MVP release with portal-first Wayland colour picking, compositor/helper fallbacks where available, native Qt styling, and transparent packaged app icons.

ul.li: Initial v1.0.0 MVP with screen picking, preview, clipboard copy, and transparent app icons.
